summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Variant Perception Cycle Aware US Equity ETF (VPX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed to select large-cap US companies based on a proprietary analysis of quality and behavioral factors.  The fund also allocates cash using a quantitative model to assess macroeconomic risk. VPX was launched on Mar 11, 2026 and is issued by Variant Perception.

holdings.infoBox: VPX is an equity ETF with a total of 129 individual holdings. The top holdings are Meta Platforms stock at 6.60%, NVIDIA at 4.99%, Alphabet at 4.83%, Broadcom at 4.69%, and Micron Technology at 4.40%.
